description: Implementation of the ContentDao interface for accessing Content entities in the database. Contains methods for retrieving contents by type, code, language, and other criteria using QueryDSL with JPA.

classes.name: ContentDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for Content entity, providing database access methods such as listing content by type, code, language, and retrieving content details.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content entities filtered by ContentType, MerchantStore, and optionally Language, ordered by sortOrder.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Retrieves list of ContentDescription objects (names and URLs) for contents of given types, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content entity based on its code and store.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Fetches a Content entity by its ID and associated language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Content entity by its ID.

methods.name: getByCode (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a Content entity by code, store, and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a ContentDescription by store and SEO URL (seUrl).
